name: Decomposition Level of Odd Tangent-Polygon Complements
proof: The dominant-shore condition forces every first decomposition block of size at most $m$ to be a consecutive $m$-block with the zero pattern, giving the lower bound. Successively adjoining all length-$(m+1)$ coordinate cubes leaves a recursively peripheral upset and reverses to a decomposition whose attachment blocks have size $m$ and whose links are recursively peripheral, giving the upper bound.
